persons.name: Jitānanda
persons.evidence: idaṃ pusaka (!) likhitaṃ śrīlalitāpuranagarasya śrīmahāvauddopāśaka (!) śrījitānandena

date.as_written: śrīvikramasamvat 1728 śrīśākesamvat 1918 śrīnepālasamvat 981 sālamiti śrāvaṇavadi 13 ravidine

notes: The colophon gives three eras with apparent confusion in the labels and numbers: Vikrama Samvat 1728, Śāke Samvat 1918, and Nepāla Samvat 981. The year 1918 actually corresponds to Vikrama Samvat (and NS 981), both yielding c. 1861 CE.
